original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independent finite check of the support-seven (Fano) exclusion in research/centre-seven-owner-information-floor: re-derive the 112 routes via the chart-swap derivation, recompute all cyclically reduced length-six route relations with a separate exact product, and replace the written braid/triangle step with exhaustive searches over support-seven incidence structures and Fano flag labellings.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for an independent check of one new implication. The newest unreviewed implication on the centre-path lever is the support-seven exclusion archived on 2026-10-16 without scientific replay; this package checks exactly that step and nothing downstream.
bottleneck_link: The centre path takes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call. The audited package rules out information compression of the shared centre repair through blocks of at most seven owners; this check makes that negative result rest on two implementations instead of one.
stop_rule: Stop after the census and both exhaustive searches agree with the audited receipt, or report the first disagreement. Do not extend to eight-owner blocks.
evidence: RESULT.json; verify.py reproduces it in about 30 s on CPython 3.13 (standard library only). The audited package's own verify.py also passed on the same host in about 60 s.
author: Sudarsh Chaturvedi
ai_assistance: Substantial assistance from Claude (Anthropic) for implementation and writing; no independent human review claimed.

open_questions.question: Does open PR #3147's block floor for 8 to 12 owners (head 5cbc48b18cb05327a8dacab3f626412d3bc5e924) survive an independent search?
open_questions.why_it_matters: #3147 extends the centre-repair information floor from 7 to 12 owners. Its circle-cancellation part was audited in #3149/#3151, but the block-floor part has no independent check.
open_questions.first_step: List incidence structures on 8 to 12 points with line size >= 3, point degree >= 3 and pair multiplicity <= 1, then run labelings() over each, adding length-8 relations from a reduced 4-against-4 product census where needed.
open_questions.blocked_by: None for the check itself; relevance to kappa stays gated by the audited package's replacement-endpoint screen.
